description: Mikrotik RouterOS static DNS, /ip/dns/static, over its API. See docs/mikrotik.md.

address.description: The router, with a port unless the default: 8728, or 8729 with TLS.

use_tls.description: The API over TLS, the api-ssl service.

tls_fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's certificate, in hex, when it can't be verified otherwise. Without it, the certificate must be valid.

username.description: A user with the read, write and api policies.

zone.description: The zone of the names: lan.
